goal: Stop updating chainstate and index markers when writing block or undo files to disk fails
Prevents database corruption where stored chain state points to blocks never durably saved
agreement: Strong support for preventing corruption when block flushes fail (mzumsande, optout21, arejula27, pzafonte)
Verified locally and confirmed that the test fails without the fix (optout21, arejula27)
Unanswered question on whether flush retries after requested shutdown should succeed (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents chainstate and indexes from advancing past durably written block data
Avoids data corruption when block storage encounters permanent write or fsync failures
